observations: Only the self-application context-hygiene Candidate can affect repository-development publication discipline.
The Candidate remains unverified for activation and is restricted to one reversible trial.
All acceptance criteria remain frozen by the execution unit.
fragment.purpose: Pre-application Candidate evaluation for the Revision-20 audit native-record publication.

local_learn.observation: A noisy repository-development worktree makes context hygiene relevant, but applicability alone is not activation evidence.

result.applicability: APPLICABLE: the publication unit must reconstruct an exact latest-main branch from a locally noisy repository-development context while preserving authority, source provenance, immutable requests, and a closed file allowlist.
result.baseline_reason: The frozen publication unit already defines a path-level allowlist, exact-head CI, expected-head merge, and exact-readback baseline. The Candidate may organize context and recording only; it may not change those acceptance criteria.
result.dependency_conflict_status: No declared dependency or conflict. Use only as a reversible scoped trial; do not promote or activate it globally.
evidence_to_collect: latest remote main commit and exact generation-7 state blob before branch construction
the complete closed allowlist and an explicit list of excluded obsolete, unrelated, temporary, and stale-owner files
work-verify, JSON, focused pytest, diff, exact-head CI, mergeability, expected-head merge, and path-by-path readback evidence
proof that invoke-7ae7a7ae6a1ddf359cb11335 remains without a response
result.non_applicability_reason: These Candidates target capability benchmarks, campaign authoring, live providers, stage isolation, request rendezvous, or workspace campaigns; none improves a native-record-only publication.
regression_checks: no semantic source, protocol, baseline, inbox, strategy, Candidate authority, or external system changes
no stale generation-6 response or obsolete connector receipt enters the commit
no temporary response/projection file enters the commit
all Revision-20 broad-negative flags remain false and INSUFFICIENT_EQUIVALENCE_EVIDENCE remains scoped to the artifact-to-contract audit
no internal publication evidence becomes behavioral, AGI, or completion evidence

risk_dimensions.failure_risk: Moderate because the worktree contains unrelated historical records; fail closed unless the committed diff equals the allowlist exactly.
risk_dimensions.latency_tokens: Moderate path audit plus CI wait; no semantic experiment is added.
risk_dimensions.quality: The overlay should reduce accidental inclusion of unrelated local records and stale authority.
risk_dimensions.tool_external_cost: One isolated branch, push, PR, exact-head CI observation, expected-head merge, and readback are authorized by the unit.

result.rollback: Discard the Candidate trial and stop publication mutation if it alters acceptance criteria, includes an unreviewed path, or weakens claim boundaries. Retain the isolated branch and exact mismatch evidence only.
